title: Harden shell command and CLI argument injection boundaries
description: 1. Escape t.phase with shq and use printf in frontend/src/views/task-logs.ts local log stream command.\n2. Validate cluster names against NAME_RE and shell-quote all temporary kubeconfig paths in frontend/src/model/clusters.ts; reject unknown targets in bootstrap().\n3. Validate resource/context identifiers against SAFE_RESOURCE_RE (no leading '-') in frontend/src/model/store.ts before invoking ax CLI.
close_reason: Escaped t.phase in task-logs.ts, enforced NAME_RE and shell-quoted temp paths in clusters.ts, and validated resource/context identifiers with isSafeResourceName in store.ts

title: Harden temporary file paths, Webview CSP, and screenshot static server
description:
1. Move Shell.KubeconfigFor() temp files in shell.go and buildx digest files in docker-shim.sh out of shared /tmp into user-scoped 0700 directories.
2. Tighten shimDir permissions in ContainerRuntime() to 0700.
3. Add defense-in-depth Content-Security-Policy meta tag to frontend/index.html.
4. Add path-traversal containment guard in hack/screenshots.mjs.
close_reason: Moved KubeconfigFor and docker-shim buildx digests to 0700 user-scoped dirs, tightened shimDir permissions, added Webview CSP meta tag, and guarded static server path traversal

3. Add Linux ~/.cache/ms-playwright discovery in frontend/vitest.config.ts and hack/screenshots.mjs.
4. Expand .golangci.yml linters and ignore frontend/package.json.md5.
5. Add regression tests in shell_test.go and frontend/src/views.test.ts and pass make check.
close_reason: Applied process-group termination to interactive sessions, capped toolLog at 200 entries, added cross-platform Playwright Chromium discovery, enabled standard golangci-lint linters, untracked frontend/package.json.md5, and verified make check passes
